headline: Put your Home Assistant dashboard on the big screen
intro: Discover Google Cast devices on your network and bring them into Home Assistant. Send a dashboard view to a Chromecast, play HTTP(S) media, or start audio and video from automations and scripts.
highlights: Show a selected Home Assistant dashboard view on a Cast device
Play accessible HTTP(S) audio, video, and images with media player actions
Find devices with mDNS or add known hosts when automatic discovery is unavailable

flow.title: Send a dashboard to a display
